purpose: Assess public-data-only attainability without inspecting secrets or fresh submissions
forbidden_inputs: evaluation scores during fitting or selection

variants.name: midpoint_prior
variants.algorithm: Known coupling signs times the midpoint of public magnitude bounds; midpoint background fields

variants.name: empirical_log_bridge
variants.algorithm: Jeffreys-smoothed six-spin training histograms; affine interpolation/extrapolation of log probabilities in beta; exact local-field exponential reweighting

variants.name: latent_fit_weak
variants.algorithm: Exact latent marginal likelihood over all 16384 public configurations, box-constrained L-BFGS-B

variants.name: latent_fit_strong
variants.algorithm: Exact latent marginal likelihood over all 16384 public configurations, box-constrained L-BFGS-B
variants.initialization: public prior midpoint independently of the weak fit

regularization_definition: 0.5 * coefficient * sum(((parameter - public_bound_midpoint) / public_bound_halfwidth)^2), added to mean configuration negative log likelihood
fit_selection_rule: Lowest training regularized objective visited within the fixed budget, never a hidden score
evaluation_policy: Complete and hash-seal every variant before the first trusted evaluation; no fitting or output changes after scoring
compute: four CPU cores, float64, no GPU; no fresh agents
failure_policy: Record numerical/time failures or incomplete variants; do not extend to an hour
